task_objective: Port right-stick navigation from dimmujed/Right-Stick-Navigation natively into decky-loader for any dual-joystick handheld/controller, add a General Settings toggle (default OFF), and verify functional behavior and performance live on steamdeck-vm across both Steam Beta (ESM) and Steam Stable (Webpack).
tests_added: tests/frontend/right_stick_navigation.test.mts (4 unit tests: focusedWindow validates gamescope/desktop rules, findGamepadSourceBase walks prototype chain, controller handles direction push/hysteresis/focus loss/suspend/disable release, controller clears held direction on stop)
design_decisions: Universal dual-stick evdev discovery (ABS_X + ABS_Y + ABS_RX + ABS_RY + BTN_SOUTH) with Steam Deck hidraw (0x28DE:0x1205) fallback so any handheld or controller (Legion Go S, ROG Ally, Steam Deck, Xbox, DualSense, Switch Pro) works out of the box.
Zero-overhead disabled state: default OFF (rightStickNavigation = false) spawns no reader thread, opens zero input fds, registers no event listener, and runs no frontend focus timer.
Event-driven kernel-blocked libc::poll() + inotify /dev/input hotplug + push-only WebSocket EVENT (loader/right_stick_direction) instead of upstream's 4 Hz long-poll RPC loop.
Multi-controller ControllerArbiter with per-device centering, active-controller handoff, and automatic release on unplug or disable.
Resilient prototype-chain walk (findGamepadSourceBase) to construct a synthetic GamepadInputSource across both Steam Beta (ESM) and Steam Stable (Webpack).

local_validation.frontend: lint, typecheck, build (dfl-global & no-entry-reimport), and 30/30 node --test passed
